profile.reason.customDefined: A custom check you defined, so it is included
profile.reason.defaultRequiredBlocking: Required and blocking by default in the catalog
profile.reason.defaultRequired: Required by default in the catalog
profile.reason.defaultOptional: Optional: not in the full scan until you include it
profile.reason.alwaysOn: Always on, outside the index, and it keeps the verdict from «Pure» until what it finds is reviewed
profile.reason.conditionMet: Its condition is met, so it is required
profile.reason.audienceUndeclared: The audience is not declared, so it is treated as «public», the safest choice. Declare it to change this
profile.reason.conditionUnmet: Its condition is not met, so it stays optional
profile.reason.audienceExcludes: The declared audience ({audience}) does not require it
profile.reason.userOverride: You changed it in the standards profile: {fields}
profile.reason.disabledByUser: You disabled it in the standards profile
profile.reason.commandFromScript: The command comes from the project script “{script}”
profile.reason.commandFromTool: The command calls the project’s tool “{tool}” directly
profile.reason.managedTool: Run by a tool AYAR manages: {tool}
profile.reason.builtIn: AYAR runs it itself, without the project’s commands
profile.signal.code.any: no code in a supported language (JS, TS or Python)
profile.signal.styles.any: no CSS styles or style blocks
profile.signal.markup.any: no HTML, CSS or Markdown files
profile.signal.ui.rendered: no interface rendered in a browser
profile.signal.ui.rtl: no interface declaring a right-to-left language
profile.signal.type.chromiumExtension: not a Chromium extension with Manifest V3
profile.signal.types.config: no type configuration (tsconfig, mypy or pyright)
profile.signal.lint.config: no declared linter (ESLint, Biome or Ruff)
profile.signal.site.staticNoScripts: not a static site without scripts
profile.signal.ext.manifestGenerated: the manifest is not generated by the build
profile.ref.states: no declared UI states with expectations
profile.invalid.consistency: A required check cannot be left out of the full scan ({instance}).
profile.invalid.sudo: The command uses sudo, so it was refused ({instance}).
profile.invalid.explicit_sensitive: The variable “{name}” is sensitive; its value is never written in the profile. Allow it by name instead.
profile.invalid.unknown_check: A check the catalog does not know ({instance}).
profile.invalid.approve_alone: A dangerous command is approved on its own ({instance}).
profile.invalid.not_pending: This check is not awaiting approval ({instance}).
profile.invalid.too_large: The standards profile is larger than the limit.
profile.invalid.not_json: The standards profile is not valid JSON.
profile.invalid.schema: The standards profile does not match the ayar-profile/1 schema ({path}).
profile.invalid.secret_in_export: The export was stopped because its text holds a high-confidence secret pattern ({rules}).
profile.change.changed: Its spec changed since the approval
profile.approveAlone: A dangerous command: approved on its own, never with “Approve all”.
profile.withheldEnv.title: Variables not passed to the check
profile.withheldEnv.allowWarning: “{name}” will be passed to this check, and its value redacted from the logs. Allow it only if the check needs it.
profile.import.needsApproval: The standards profile was imported, and every command in it needs approval again.
profile.export.preview: Preview the differences before writing into the repository
profile.repoProfile.available: The repository has a standards profile. Using it requires approving its commands.
profile.invalid.secret_in_profile: The standards profile holds a secret ({rules}), so it was not saved. Pass the secret as an environment variable allowed by name instead of writing it in the profile.
profile.invalid.outside_project: The repository’s standards profile points outside the project, so it was not read.
profile.invalid.too_deep: The standards profile is nested deeper than the limit, so it was refused.
